column1: # One row per public field of the client, server and publisher copies, in digest order.
# Columns (see README.md): owner = client | server | publisher; name = the Java field; type = a scalar,
# an enum's binary class name, or tail (the server's retained movement list); digest = how StateDigest
# folds the field (raw, bool, int, long, unsigned, id, ordinal, tail, none), or again = a second fold
# of an inherited client field into the server digest, which is neither copied nor written again;
# schema = the first boundary schema that carries the field (server rows only may be above 1).
